'''Alex Alcalde All Droids...All the Time!!''' is a [[Young Jedi]] Sith list published on the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] GeoCities site. [[Alex Alcalde]] posted it as '''Gold 31'''.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alex Alcalde]]
* '''Published:''' by 9 July 2000 (Corellian Engineering Corporation)
* '''Format:''' [[Young Jedi]]
* '''Side:''' Sith
* '''Strategy:''' All Droids...All the Time!!
